label: Clinical Teal
description: Calm medical blue with a fresh teal accent on a cool white page. Reads clean and reassuring — suits hospitals, clinics, dental, diagnostics and pathology labs.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. Deliberately low-saturation: healthcare pages are read by people who are worried, and a loud palette works against that. A single humanist sans across headings and body keeps it legible rather than styled.
_contrastNote: secondary/accent/muted walked down their own hue until each clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 on both bg and surface (were secondary 4.50, accent 3.12/2.87, muted 4.46 on surface). Fixed at source so every site on this theme — including Aayas Dental — reads properly.
